subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw advance the per-agent SQLite schema from v11 to v12 to persist ACP parent-stream diagnostics as part of this journal migration?
rationale: Repository policy reserves schema-version advances for explicit user discussion and acceptance; the PR and available discussion do not show that approval.

options.title: Accept the v12 migration
options.body: Approve the scoped agent-database upgrade after reviewing its retention, session-deletion, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep ACP diagnostics out of this change
options.body: Defer the ACP table and schema bump, while separately considering the journal migrations that fit existing shared/plugin state owners.

recommendation.title: Accept the v12 migration
recommendation.body: Approve the scoped agent-database upgrade after reviewing its retention, session-deletion, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged agent/session SQLite migration is the closest established ownership signal for the per-agent schema boundary.
